comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Implemented 2026-08-10 in 9d180293 (branch rad-sprint1). NOT yet landable - see the blocker at the end.

Went with the narrow fix, as planned: a signed operand is now admitted in the right-hand position of `??` and `catch`, rather than moving unary below `??` in the precedence cascade. Reordering would be the more principled precedence (every other language with a coalescing operator binds unary tighter), but it silently reinterprets `-a ?? b` and `not a ?? b`, making it a breaking change owing the three-layer migration. The narrow fix is purely additive.

**Widened slightly from the card.** The card proposed allowing a negative *literal*. I allowed any signed postfix operand, so `?? -n`, `?? -get()` and `?? -xs[0]` all work too. Restricting to literals would have traded one confusing parse error for another - `?? -1` working while `?? -count` failed.

**Grammar (~/src/tree-sitter-rad, uncommitted):**

    _signed_operand: $ => alias($._signed_postfix, $.unary_expr),
    _signed_postfix: $ => prec(PREC.unary, seq(
      field("op", $._unary_op_sign),
      field("arg", $._postfix_expr),
    )),

The `alias` to `unary_expr` is the load-bearing part: the new syntax produces a node kind consumers already handle, so `rts/converter.go`, `rts/check/` and `rts/radfmt/` all needed **zero changes** - `convertFallback`/`convertCatchExpr` already delegate generically on the right field, and `rad fmt` round-trips the new forms untouched. No new node kinds or field names, so `rl/consts.go` needs no update either (per tree-sitter-rad AGENTS.md).

Verified: all repro forms work, `rad check` clean, `rad fmt` round-trips, full rad suite green, no existing snapshot changed. Snapshot cases added to control_flow/fallback.snap and catch_expr.snap.

Also removed the `?? (-1)` workaround from the index_of docs, which were teaching the idiom this fix removes.

**Blocked on release.** The grammar change is unreleased, so the two new snapshot cases fail against tree-sitter-rad v0.6.0. To land: release tree-sitter-rad (v0.6.1), bump go.mod, drop the local replace directive (currently unstaged).

Note for whoever releases: regenerating in that repo also picked up two changes that are not part of this fix - FIELDS.md/NODES.md were stale since ac743bd (missing the `group` field), and src/tree_sitter/alloc.h + array.h drifted because the local tree-sitter CLI is 0.23.2. Decide whether those ride along.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
RE-VERIFIED 2026-06-14 (rad v0.10.1): still reproduces (both forms error RAD10009; the `?? (-1)` workaround works).

Writing a negative number literal as the fallback value for ?? or catch causes a parse error.

**Repro:**
r = parse_int("x") ?? -1      // error[RAD10009]: Unexpected '-'
r = risky() catch -1          // error[RAD10009]: Unexpected '-'

**Workarounds:**
- Parentheses: `?? (-1)`  (confirmed working)
- A variable: `fallback = -1; r = parse_int("x") ?? fallback`
- Arithmetic: `?? (0 - 1)`

The parser does not recognize unary minus in this position. Natural to write - any user using ?? / catch with negative defaults hits it.

**Fix (slam dunk):** allow a unary-minus literal as the RHS of `??` / `catch` in the parser. The parens workaround proves it is purely a parsing gap.
title: ?? and catch cannot parse negative literal on right side
